name: Secret Arcade — nonland permanents you control are enchantments
notes: Sweep theme 5 (2026-10-06). "Nonland permanents you control and permanent spells you control are enchantments in addition to their other types." produced nothing: the compound subject with "permanent spells" matched no filter. Spells are not on the board, so the permanents half is parsed alone. With both doors unlocked your creature gains Enchantment, your land does not, and an opponent's creature does not.
